name: @psyb0t/wickworks
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted wickworks service over MCP — OHLC bars in, technical indicators + Smart-Money-Concepts primitives out.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running wickworks instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp/), exposing its stateless technical-analysis tools: health, list_indicators (the registered indicator types), metadata (the human-readable catalog of every output path), and compute (candlestick bars + an indicator/SMC selection in, computed primitives out — no scoring, no opinions, no state). wickworks is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-wickworks.

WICKWORKS_URL.description: Base URL of your running wickworks server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /mcp/).

WICKWORKS_TOKEN.description: Bearer token — only if you front wickworks with a reverse proxy that requires connection-level auth (wickworks itself ships auth-less).
